RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the March 4, 2008/Phalguna 14, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
26
Setting up of international airports in
Madhya Pradesh
†*81. SHRIMATI MAY A SINGH: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of airports operating in
Madhya Pradesh at present alongwith the
locations thereof;
(b) whether any proposal is under
consideration of Government for
construction of new airports of
international standard in order to extend
facility for movement of the people of
Madhya Pradesh as also to promote
tourism; and
(c) if so, by when the construction work
of these airports would be started?
Strength of employees in PSUs
*82. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI PRASANTA CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of permanent employees
working in PSUs under the administrative
control of his Ministry as on 31 March,
2007 (unit-wise break up); and
(b) the number of contract/casual/
contingency workers working in these units
as on 31 March, 2007?
Losses incurred by Air India
*83. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR :
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
the original financial documents presented
to the Board, Air India had recorded its
biggest ever net loss of Rs. 541.3 crore for
the financial year 2006-07;
(b) whether it is also a fact that airline's
poor on time record and disregard for
passenger comfort has resulted in what a
Board member described as 'a loss of
customer confidence'; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and the
action proposed to address the issue?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

27
Inflation rate in India
†*84. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the
period from September, 2007 to January,
2008, the inflation rate in India has remained
high in comparison to the other leading
economies of the world;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what has been the average inflation
rate during the above said period in America,
England, European countries, Japan and
China; and
(d) the extent to which this rate is more
or less, in comparison to the average
inflation rate of India?
Fall in the Sensex
*85. SHRI P.R. RAJAN:
SHRIMATI  SUSHMA  SWARAJ:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has assessed
the reasons for the recent fall in the Sensex;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of loss incurred by
investors in the recent crash of Sensex; and
(d) the amount of money Government
had to pump in for saving the Sensex from
further going down?
Restoration work of monuments in
Rajasthan and Sikkim
*86. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) what is Government's policy for
undertaking restoration/maintenance work
of temples, churches, mosques and other
monuments, particularly in the States of
Rajasthan and Sikkim;
(b) the details of work of each of these
temples, churches, mosques and other
monuments in the above States;
(c) the details of funds sanctioned and
expenditure incurred; and
(d) the details of projects in pipeline?
New licensing policy for oil and gas
exploration
†*87. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the production of oil and
gas in the oil and gas reserves found in
Krishna Godavari basin, Tapti Gas area and
Bikaner region of Rajasthan will be started
in the year 2008;
(b) if so, the total quantum of oil and
gas to be made available from these areas;
(c) whether Government has prepared
any new licensing policy for the exploration
of oil and gas; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

28
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Amendments to the Income Tax Act,
1961
*88. SHRI M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
bring out the necessary amendments to
Section 10(17) of the Income Tax Act, 1961
providing exemption of tax on all
allowances to Members of Legislative
Assembly of Andhra Pradesh at par with
the Members of Parliament;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether any respresentation in this
respect has been received from the State
Government of Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) if so, what action has been taken
thereon by the Central Government?
